name: Text 30
text: AI is not one generic feature. Each model solves a specific technical problem and connects to the application through the backend.

name: Text 2
text: TrainCore AI is implemented as a local feed-forward neural network. It receives fitness goal, gender, physical measures, training level, workout location, frequency, preferred intensity, injuries, pain points and available equipment. After numerical preprocessing, the model assigns a suitability score from 0 to 1 to each candidate exercise. Higher-scoring exercises are selected while safety filters remove conflicts with physical limitations.
TrainCore in the actual mobile app
Goal, level, location and injuries are read from the saved profile.
TrainCore scores candidate exercises; safety rules exclude conflicts.
The PHP backend stores the plan and returns it to the phone.

name: Text 2
text: NutriCore AI is a local neural-network model that estimates meal suitability. It combines nutritional targets with calories, macronutrients, allergies, disliked foods, preferences and available fridge ingredients. Candidate meals are scored by the model, then passed through filtering and validation before reaching the user.

name: Text 24
text: AI recommends. Rules protect. Experts approve.
NutriCore: plans, fridge and approved meals
The fridge feature proposes swaps using ingredients the user already has.

name: Text 36
text: PoseForm converts recorded exercise video into structured technical feedback by extracting landmarks, analyzing movement phases and joint angles, estimating repetitions, scoring form, and returning corrective guidance.
From uploaded video to form feedback
The phone sends a complete exercise clip.
MediaPipe finds body joints frame by frame.
Angles and movement phases estimate reps and form.
The phone displays score, mistakes and feedback.

name: Text 1
text: Why AI Alone Is Not Enough

name: Text 20
text: Nutrition recommendations are filtered for allergies and user constraints, generated meals are reviewed before acceptance, and exercise resources are subject to review. This design improves reliability and demonstrates responsible AI integration in a health and fitness context.
Onboarding and expert review in the app

name: Text 18
text: The prototype integrates multiple forms of artificial intelligence into one mobile system. TrainCore produced stable suitability predictions, NutriCore combined high validation performance with safety filtering, and PoseForm returned structured exercise feedback.
Internal project tests; these metrics do not establish clinical performance for new users.

name: Text 1
text: From Functional Prototype to Production System

name: Text 3
text: The current system is a functional prototype validated mainly in a local development environment. The datasets remain limited compared with commercial platforms, PoseForm depends on recorded videos and recording conditions, and long-term validation with a large population of real users has not yet been performed.

name: Text 4
text: Future development can expand the datasets, introduce more regional nutrition data, support more exercises, improve analysis across varied conditions, enable real-time feedback, and move toward secure production deployment.

name: Text 2
text: FROM USER DATA  →  TO AI  →  TO PERSONALIZED ACTION

name: Text 3
text: Elite Fitness demonstrates how mobile development, backend engineering, database systems, artificial intelligence, computer vision, safety validation, and gamification can work together inside one practical application. The key contribution is not a single AI model, but the integration of multiple specialized models into a complete personalized fitness ecosystem.
